versions.changelog:
- Initial release of legal-case-validator-mctmilk.
- Enables verification of statutory analysis using real legal cases.
- Helps users identify judicial practice trends such as common case types, judgment divergences, high-frequency causes of loss, and key points for judicial review.
- Strictly reminds users to cross-check AI-generated case information against official databases (China Judgments Online, PKU Law, Faxin).
- Provides a detailed query and analysis framework, but emphasizes that real cases must be independently validated.
- Supports practitioners and users in ensuring statutory analysis aligns with actual judicial practice.
